summary: B12X now comes from FlashInfer 0.7.1, which carries it as flashinfer/experimental/b12x with the same b12x import package
compatibility: The container installs FlashInfer 0.7.1 and no separate b12x wheel: both own the b12x namespace, so a standalone b12x package must not be installed next to it.
details: The standalone B12X repository is archived; its code continues in FlashInfer, whose wheel also installs the top-level b12x package that vLLM imports.
The vllm[b12x] extra now installs flashinfer-python[b12x]==0.7.1 (the pinned CuTe DSL) instead of b12x==1.3.0.
